display_title: The Difficulties Faced by a Married Couple

titles_en.title: The Difficulties Faced by a Married Couple

description:
Long, long ago, deep within the towering forest, there existed a world inhabited only by humanoids. Among them, two adjacent mountains were home to the Fox Tribe and the Wolf Tribe, living separately. The beastmen from these two tribes fought constantly, like sworn enemies, and caught in the crossfire was the small village of herbivorous beastmen nestled between the mountains. 

*“Please stop fighting! If this keeps up, we'll all pack up and move away!!”*

Finally, the furious herbivore-type humanoids declared a strike, forcing the Fox Tribe and Wolf Tribe to prepare a wedding for peace. Thus, Hwang Mi-Ho of the Fox Tribe and Jang Woo-Rang of the Wolf Tribe were chosen as representatives of their tribes and bound in matrimony.

*“What?! You have no shame?! How could you...”

“What's so terrible about spending the first night together? Ah, could this be your first time?”*

They intended to create harmony through marriage, but will this truly lead to a happy ending... for everyone?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
